name: Injected trusted server-context private food-draft adapter
phase: Specification only; implementation requires separate explicit authorization
objective: Construct a request-scoped shared identity resolver from supplied trusted environment and Astro-like session dependencies, then delegate private food runtime acquisition to FOOD-001F without routes, global acquisition or activation.

input.shape: One trusted input containing environment: FoodPrivateDraftRuntimeEnvironment & { readonly RIVER_IDENTITY_DB?: unknown }, session: AstroSessionLike, and optional now?: () => Date
requirements: Accept generic supplied environment and request-appropriate Astro-like session dependencies only; no full Astro context, raw cookies, request bodies, redirects or response objects.
Do not import cloudflare:workers or acquire globals/environment directly.
Reuse FOOD-001A/B/C/D/E/F and the committed shared identity Astro session API compatibility correction unchanged.

environmentResponsibilities: FOOD-001G validates only its adapter-owned identity dependency RIVER_IDENTITY_DB.
FOOD-001F exclusively validates RIVER_FOOD_DB and RIVER_FOOD_ADMIN_PRINCIPAL_ID. Do not duplicate, normalize, infer or prevalidate these food-specific keys.
Pass the exact original environment object unchanged to FOOD-001F. Do not clone, filter or reconstruct it or scan alternate database keys.
structuralValidation: Require outer input, environment, session and RIVER_IDENTITY_DB to be non-null non-array objects; missing or malformed values fail closed.
Require callable session.get, session.set, session.delete, session.regenerate and session.destroy without invoking them.
Preserve shared contracts: get may resolve synchronously or asynchronously; set/delete remain synchronous; regenerate remains asynchronous; destroy may be synchronous or asynchronous.
Require callable identity database.prepare only. Do not require batch, probe prepared statements or require bind/first during construction.
Never fall back to another database, inferred identity or alternate authentication infrastructure.

An omitted or undefined now uses AstroPrincipalSessionStore's existing default clock; a callable now is injected exactly; explicit null or any noncallable value fails closed. Never invoke the clock during construction.
Catch throwing property access on all adapter-owned inputs and dependencies, including method/clock getters, without leaking exceptions or dependency values.
Validate all adapter-owned inputs before constructing downstream identity components or invoking FOOD-001F.
constructionFlow: After adapter-owned structural validation succeeds, construct AstroPrincipalSessionStore with the exact session and optional clock.
Construct D1PrincipalRepository from the extracted RIVER_IDENTITY_DB.
Construct DefaultSessionPrincipalResolver with the newly constructed sessions and principals.
Call createPrivateFoodDraftRuntimeFromEnvironment with the exact original environment and newly constructed request-scoped callerResolver; return its result unchanged.
Construct a fresh session store, principal repository and resolver for every invocation; never cache across requests.

result.failure: { ok: false, error: { code: 'configuration-unavailable', message: 'Food draft runtime configuration is unavailable.' } }
result.fixedFailureMessage: Food draft runtime configuration is unavailable.
requirements: Reuse FOOD-001E/F's service-only result exactly; introduce no adapter error vocabulary.
Expose no environment, session, identity database, principal repository, resolver, food database, administrator ID or repository internals.
Failures expose no dependency values, getter exceptions, SQL/D1 details, configuration internals or stack traces. Preserve FOOD-001F configuration failures unchanged.

constructionGuarantees: Construction is synchronous and I/O-free, returning a result rather than a promise.
Do not call session methods, identity database.prepare, prepared statements, resolver.resolve, food database methods, repository/service operations, clock or schema/migration/session probes.

Structural success proves construction compatibility only, not a valid live session, identity or food database/schema availability, migration application, environment provenance, correct request scoping, principal activity or administrator authorization.
laterOperationSemantics: Preserve awaited asynchronous Astro session reads and existing unauthenticated behavior for missing session data.
Malformed/expired sessions may delete the principal-session key; preserve expiry-boundary and cleanup failure behavior.
Rejected session reads follow the existing resolver unavailable path without malformed-session deletion or principal lookup.
Missing/inactive/mismatched principals preserve existing session-destruction behavior, including synchronous destruction and failure handling.
Principal lookup may legitimately call the identity database; denied food operations make zero food database calls.
FOOD-001D remains authorization authority, including fresh resolution on every operation. River OS boolean/access-key authentication is never a substitute.

FOOD-001F validates food environment keys, FOOD-001E composes the service, and FOOD-001C remains persistence/concurrency authority. Preserve exact arguments/outcomes and introduce no readiness or sale-authority projection.
tests: Valid construction delegates with the exact original environment and a newly constructed resolver; returns FOOD-001F's result unchanged.
Fresh session store, principal repository and resolver per invocation; request isolation and no cross-request cache.
Service-only output exposes no dependency or internal bypass surface.
Missing/null/array/non-object/malformed and throwing outer/environment/session/identity dependencies fail closed before identity construction or FOOD-001F invocation.
Test each of the five required session methods individually missing/noncallable/throwing.
Missing/malformed identity database and missing/noncallable/throwing prepare fail closed; batch is not required and prepared statements are not probed.
Omitted/undefined clocks accepted; callable clock preserved exactly; null/noncallable/throwing clocks rejected without invocation.
Exact fixed sanitized failures and unchanged FOOD-001F configuration failures; no food-key prevalidation or alternate database behavior.
Genuinely async Astro-like get, delayed valid reads, missing/malformed/expired sessions and exact expiry-boundary behavior.
Rejected reads and cleanup failures fail closed, preserving existing no-lookup behavior where applicable.
Exact canonical principal lookup and missing/inactive/mismatched principal behavior with synchronous destruction.
Fresh authorization after acquisition, wrong-administrator denial, and zero food database calls on denial even when identity lookup occurs.
Authorized food operations preserve exact arguments/outcomes through FOOD-001F/E/D/C; adapter tests do not replace FOOD-001C database-concurrency verification.
Source isolation from Cloudflare globals, routes/actions/UI, River OS boolean/access-key auth, Wrangler/config mutation, migrations, deployment and unrelated subsystem construction.
deferredScope: Food routes/actions/UI and public product access.
Actual RIVER_FOOD_DB provisioning/configuration, generated food environment typing and concrete administrator principal value.
Migration execution, runtime global environment acquisition and production activation.
Deployment, production data and unrelated insurance/Sesh/creator changes.
currentTaskBoundary: Create only this specification. Do not implement, modify existing files, stage, commit, configure runtime access, access D1, migrate or deploy.
nextStep: Review this specification before separately authorizing the two-file injected trusted server-context adapter implementation.
